args.title: Fix timeouts and memory usage in the totals endpoint on large reports
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The GET /reports/:id/totals endpoint currently takes excessively long and times out on reports with large numbers of transactions, such as 1.6 million rows. It inefficiently loads all transaction rows into memory, which consumes over a gigabyte and often triggers a database statement timeout error.

This change proposes to optimize the totals endpoint in src/api/reports.ts by avoiding loading all transactions and instead calculating just the aggregated totals per currency directly from the database if possible. This will reduce memory usage significantly and speed up the response, preventing timeouts and server errors for large reports.
